result_text:
The region manager overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. That is the same order as the sales rep list. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets stay out as before.

The change is the `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I also updated the method's doc comment. `RegionManagerService` is the only caller, so the overview picks it up with no further change.

The `*Region*` tests ran and passed. I didn't add a test for the T-1 to T-5 example, so that ordering isn't checked by one.
